hints.title: Dual Pointer Traversal with Run Skipping
hints.text: Advance indices through word and abbreviation, parsing integer run lengths to advance the word position accordingly.

hints.title: Rejecting Leading Zeros in Numeric Segments
hints.text: A numeric skip value must never begin with character 0. If a digit character is zero at the start of a number, the abbreviation is invalid.

hints.title: Character Verification and Boundary Check
hints.text: Parse digits into an integer and increment word pointer by that amount. If a character is encountered, compare directly with word character. Ensure both pointers reach end simultaneously.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space matching string lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding the full expanded abbreviation string allocates unnecessary memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual pointers inspect character alignment directly without allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explicitly handle leading zero digits like 01 and handle pointer out of bounds cleanly.
